easytrade.title: Easytrade
easytrade.description: Invoices, expenses, financial transactions and Z reports arriving from Easytrade automatically. Period from the top bar.
easytrade.empty: Connect with the taxpayer's Easytrade user; data then arrives by the scheduled sync.
easytrade.f_email_hint: The email and password you use to sign in to Easytrade at pro.easytradetr.com.
easytrade.f_company_id_hint: Leave it empty: at sign-in the company your Easytrade account belongs to is used. If you enter another ID, that company is still used. It is not the 6-digit customer number.
easytrade.company_used: Your Easytrade account belongs to {{company}} (ID {{id}}); that company was used.
easytrade.fill_first: Enter the email and password first.
easytrade.connect_hint: The password is not stored; only the 30-day session token is kept in the credential vault.
easytrade.connected: Easytrade connected. The first sync starts within minutes.
easytrade.schedule_failed: Could not save the sync interval.
easytrade.webhook_none: Easytrade sends no push notifications; data arrives by the scheduled sync.
easytrade.financial_empty: No collections or payments arrived from Easytrade for this period.
easytrade.z_empty: No Z reports arrived from Easytrade for this period.
easytrade.z_unsupported: Easytrade does not offer Z reports; they arrive on their own once Easytrade opens the endpoint.
easytrade.runs_empty: The first scheduled sync runs within minutes.
easytrade.run_counts: {{invoices}} invoices · {{expenses}} expenses · {{financial}} financial transactions · {{z}} Z reports
easytrade.windows_failed: {{n}} windows failed; the next sync retries them
connections.title: Connections
connections.description: This taxpayer's bank, bookkeeping, accounting software and messaging connections in one place.
connections.easytrade_desc: Expense, sales and Z report sync from the bookkeeping app.
connections.accounting_desc: Voucher files for Luca, Zirve, Logo and Mikro, delivered by the desktop agent.
connections.whatsapp_desc: Documents and chat links from the WhatsApp Web extension.
bank.title: Bank web service
bank.description: Reads account movements from the bank's web service every day; no statement uploads needed.
bank.add_hint: Choose the bank and accounts; the branch instruction letter is prepared next.
bank.no_banks: No bank can be connected by web service yet. Upload statements instead.
bank.f_ibans_hint: One IBAN per line. These accounts are printed on the instruction.
bank.create_failed: Could not start the bank connection.
bank.empty: Once connected, account movements arrive every day on their own.
bank.egress_missing: No fixed egress IP is configured, so the instruction cannot be prepared. Tell the platform admin.
bank.hint_instruction: Download the instruction, have the taxpayer sign it and hand it to the branch.
bank.hint_submit: Mark it once the signed instruction is at the branch. The bank sends the service user after setting it up.
bank.submitted: Instruction marked as handed to the branch.
bank.hint_credentials: Stored encrypted in the vault, never shown. Saving verifies them with a one-day query.
bank.verify_failed: Could not verify the bank details.
einvoice.title: e-Invoice integrator
einvoice.description: The taxpayer's e-invoice and e-archive documents are pulled daily from the integrator's web service. Read only; nothing is changed at the integrator.
einvoice.add_hint: Pick the company the taxpayer uses for e-invoices. Next you enter the web-service user the integrator gave.
einvoice.created: Connection opened. Now enter the web-service user.
einvoice.empty: Once an integrator is connected, incoming and outgoing e-invoices flow in here without manual upload.
einvoice.auth_failed: The integrator refused the user name or password. Check and enter them again.
einvoice.hint_waiting: Saved; the first sync runs from our fixed-IP server. The result shows here within a few minutes.
einvoice.hint_ip_filtered: This integrator needs no user; it authorises by our fixed IP and the taxpayer's tax ID. First sync running.
einvoice.hint_credentials: Stored in the encrypted vault and never shown again. The first sync starts after saving.
einvoice.unavailable: The job queue is off on this server; syncs cannot start. Tell your administrator.
einvoice.need_user: Enter the integrator's web-service user first.
einvoice.vault_missing: The credential vault is not set up on the server; tell your administrator.
einvoice.test_ok: Connection works: the integrator accepted the user.
einvoice.test_permission: This user has no web-service permission, or our server's IP address is not registered with the integrator.
einvoice.test_timeout: The integrator did not answer in time (timeout). Try again shortly.
einvoice.test_unavailable: The integrator's service is not answering. Try again shortly.
einvoice.test_rate_limit: Too many attempts; try again in a few minutes.
einvoice.test_failed: The test could not be run.
accounting.title: Accounting software
accounting.description: If the taxpayer issues invoices in Paraşüt or KolayBi, sales and purchase invoices and expenses are read here. Nothing is changed in the software.
accounting.parasut_desc: The taxpayer consents once with their Paraşüt account; then you choose the company.
accounting.parasut_hint: Paraşüt's consent page opens. After signing in with the taxpayer's account and consenting, you return to this tab.
accounting.kolaybi_desc: Connects with the API key from KolayBi Settings > API.
accounting.kolaybi_hint: The key is verified and stored in the encrypted vault; it is never shown again.
accounting.kolaybi_refused: KolayBi refused this key. Check it.
accounting.no_company: No readable company in this account.
accounting.not_configured: This connection is not set up on the server yet; tell your administrator.
accounting.server_disabled: This connection is coming soon. Until then invoices come from the e-invoice connection or file uploads.
accounting.throttled: Less than 5 minutes since the last sync; try again shortly.
accounting.callback_failed: Could not process the Paraşüt consent.
accounting.callback_lost: Could not tell which taxpayer the consent was for. Try again from the taxpayer's Connections tab.
einvoice.progress_queued: First sync queued; it starts with this month's invoices shortly.
einvoice.progress_recent: This month: {{n}} invoices so far. This month and last month come first.
einvoice.progress_history: This month: {{n}} invoices, fetching earlier months ({{done}}/{{total}}).
einvoice.progress_done: First load complete. This month: {{n}} invoices; the previous {{total}} months are in too.
einvoice.progress_ready: The last two months' invoices are in the list ({{n}} from this month).
